description: Changes Your GitHub builds of a builder app. With install and repo: picks that repository for the app (it must be empty, or one this app pushed to before; Android builds put the app's signing key into its Actions secrets). With install and create: creates a private repository in that GitHub organization (only when the Builds app may; on personal accounts the customer creates an empty one on GitHub and gives the app access). With teamId, ascConnection and/or iosAppStore: iOS signing for builds there (Apple Team ID, 10 letters and digits; ascConnection = a workspace App Store Connect connection whose key AppForShare sets as the repository secrets before each iOS build, null = the customer adds the secrets themselves; iosAppStore true = iOS builds are signed for the App Store for TestFlight and App Store review, false = for testers with an install link). With unlink: true: forgets the repository (nothing is deleted on GitHub). Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Admin role. Every plan with an account.

ascConnection.description: App Store Connect connection id, or null

create.description: Name of a new private repository in the install's organization

iosAppStore.description: true: iOS builds signed for the App Store (TestFlight, review); false: for testers

teamId.description: Apple Team ID for iOS builds

name: set_builder_github
title: Set the GitHub repository or iOS signing of a builder app
